relationships.title: Upcoming Meeting with DA Coleman on Disinformation
relationships.evidence:
[opaque block] Google Vault - upcoming meeting with DA Coleman on disinformation
"Information Resilience Council" we are seeking to stand up. The Administrator has urged us
to explore such a Council as quickly as possible, and you will all receive an Action Memo for
clearance in the next week or two proposing its basic parameters. After initial introductions
and opening remarks from DA Coleman, I will provide an overview of key lines of effort and
initiatives we hope this Council will take on and coordinate across the Agency. We will then
open the floor to your insights and questions.
As this process gets underway, we would like to request your input on the following items:
• Please ID a senior level POC (either you or a DAA) to attend roughly bimonthly
senior level meetings like this one.
• Consider who in your Bureau at the technical level who can give a portion of their
time to participate in the working group that will carry out much of the Council's
substantive work.
• Consider whatthe main challenges to your bureau are related to this issue, and
how an optimal Council mightmeaningfully address them.
Thanks so much, and please let me know if you have any questions!
Vera
Karl Fickenscher (he/him/his)

Bureau for Development, Democracy, and Innovation (DDI)
